title: Aoyagi Toya — Faith In Believing〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It is, but it shouldn't affect practice too much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey. Alright, let's start warming up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That was impressive. I couldn't react at all just now. We have soccer to thank for your good reflexes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, but I would've been called for a handball there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are you, a little kid? I've never seen that happen to anyone our age.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, that's not fair. You should be blaming the wind instead of her! Just ignore him, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I knew that it'd be windy today and I still decided to wear my cap.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll make sure to put it on more tightly so it won't blow away again.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Things finally seem like they're getting back to normal...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, don't mind me. Let's start warming up.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hm? You guys done with practice already?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Oh, can I get my usual?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Sure thing.
Hold on, no Akito or Kohane today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito's got work, and Kohane's doing something with her mom this afternoon.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: That means you're not doing an event today and are free to help out all day, right?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Gotcha! Don't worry, I'm far from shorthanded today, so enjoy your day off.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yay!
Oh, can you make me a latte?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, practice went really well again today. I can't wait for our next event!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Same. We have a new set list too, so it'll be nice to see what the crowd thinks of it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally!
Oh, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Were you and Akito talking about something before practice today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You seemed relieved or something, you know...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I had this feeling that something was going on.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. However, you have nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For a little while now, I've also been wondering if something was bothering Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But he hasn't seemed concerned or worried for a few days now, so I figured that he reached a resolution.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really...? So, you know what was bothering him?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, what?!
You said you were concerned, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I also suspect that it's something he won't tell me or can't talk about yet, so I decided not to poke or prod.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well... I was so focused on what I needed to do during practice that I didn't try and see how you guys were doing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Again, you have nothing to worry about. I only came to realize just recently.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: By the way, how long has Akito been acting this way...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can't say for certain, but likely since STAY GOLDEN...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I had no idea! Does that mean Kohane's performance has been on Akito's mind this whole time?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was under the impression that something about Kohane's performance was bothering him, but I was wrong.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He even said that he'd ask for my help if he ever ended up needing it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That sort of told me that it wasn't about him, but someone else.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, it's nothing...
But for now, sorry!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Anyway, I don't think we have anything to worry about when it comes to Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Although, he isn't always inclined to tell anyone about whatever it is that's going on.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But you saw right through all of that, right, Toya? That's what partners are for! I have a lot to learn from you in that department.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But okay...
I've had so much just on my own plate lately.
